messages.message: My name is Sanjana, and I am building a clinical-trial listing application.
My preferred clinical trial phase is Phase II.
My preferred recruitment status is Recruiting.
I prefer clinical trials sponsored by universities.
San Jose State University is a sponsor relevant to my work.
The application must never reveal private submitter email addresses.
I am especially interested in clinical studies about sleep quality.
The main study I am tracking examines sleep and academic performance.
I want answers to be concise and contain no more than five bullet points.
Please acknowledge the application preferences I have provided so far.
Clinical-trial records include a title, description, phase, recruitment status, and start date.
The trial title is the primary short-text field in my document model.
The trial description is optional and may contain additional study information.
Recruitment status is stored as a constrained category.
Trial phase is also stored as a constrained category.
MongoDB stores the document-oriented clinical-trial records.
MySQL continues to store the relational clinical-trial and sponsor records.
Short-term memory should use a sliding window of recent conversation messages.
Long-term memory should summarize important conversation information.
Episodic memory should retrieve relevant facts using embedding similarity.
The local language model used by the application is qwen3:4b.
The application backend runs on port 8601.
The MongoDB database for this assignment is named s7801_doc.
The messages collection stores user and assistant conversation turns.
The summaries collection stores session and lifetime summaries.
The episodes collection stores extracted facts, importance scores, and embeddings.
Validation errors should return clear messages and appropriate HTTP status codes.
Memory experiments should use the same conversation for every short-term window setting.
The final experiment must compare quality, token usage, and latency.
Before the memory probes, briefly confirm that you are ready to answer questions about this conversation.
